metaTitle: Custom Blue Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom blue lanyards and badges for your team. Perfect for events, offices, and schools. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Blue lanyards and badges are a popular choice for corporate events, trade shows, and school IDs because the color conveys professionalism and trust. Whether you need 3/4" woven lanyards for a conference or antimicrobial options for healthcare settings, blue offers a versatile backdrop for screen-printed or sublimated logos. Pair them with matching badge holders for a cohesive look that helps your team stand out while keeping credentials secure.
